guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：地理資訊瓦片服務
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Geographic-information tile services
guides.concept: 以投影、瓦片矩陣與空間服務一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect projections, tile matrices and spatial-service consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「座標系統」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「授權來源」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：瓦片展示與離線大量儲存可能需不同授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「區分自製瓦片與官方地圖外部連結。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「行列方向」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：XYZ 與其他約定可能有不同 Y 方向。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在四格玩具地圖比較行號翻轉。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「細節層次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：簡化幾何需平衡尺寸與拓撲保持。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具曲線簡化前後交叉關係。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「空間索引」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：包圍盒索引是候選篩選，不保證精確相交。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫兩項包圍盒重疊但幾何不交的例。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「跨平臺驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：觸控、鍵盤、縮放與 CRS 需共同驗證。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以自製瓦片規劃多螢幕離線測試。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for coordinate systems. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for licensed sources. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tile display and bulk offline storage may need different rights. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate self-made tiles from official map links. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for row/column direction. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: XYZ and other conventions may use different Y directions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare row flips on a four-cell toy map. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for levels of detail. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Geometry simplification trades size against topology. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare crossings before and after toy curve simplification. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for spatial indexes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Bounding-box indexes filter candidates, not exact intersections. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw overlapping boxes whose geometries do not intersect. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for cross-platform acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Touch, keyboard, zoom and CRS are validated together. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Plan multiscreen offline tests with self-made tiles. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「傳輸預算」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「全球資料容量就是每次看圖下載量。」為何不成立。
提交「跨平臺驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以自製瓦片規劃多螢幕離線測試。」如何辨別它們。
提交「跨平臺驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「桌面可看地圖就證明所有手機體驗正確。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for transfer budgets; explain why this claim fails: Global data size equals each viewing download.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for cross-platform acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for cross-platform acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Desktop visibility proves every mobile experience correct.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：桌面可看地圖就證明所有手機體驗正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Desktop visibility proves every mobile experience correct. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
